blocks.html: This is documentation authoring platform for Axtroid Documentation ↗.

blocks.text: Always make sure you have necessary access to work on DocStudio.

blocks.html: Before you start using DocStudio, please download the stand-alone app.

items: Once the app is downloaded on to the desktop, click to open the app.
Make sure you see instructions page.
Follow the instructions to set the real-time authoring-environment.
Click ⚙️Settings icon on the top left.
Fill the details as shown below:

blocks.html:
• Owner: axtroid
    • Repo: documentation
    • Path: docs/index.html (obtain it from your admin)
    • Branch: main
    • Personal access token: (obtain it from you admin)

blocks.text: The application must be restarted to load the latest content from the server.
